 Reclaimed and Refined Brings Resin Workshop to Marlborough

 A Rhode Island craft studio is bringing its hands-on creative workshop series to Marlborough, Massachusetts, where participants will make ocean-inspired resin charcuterie boards at Tackle Box Brewing on November 22. The two-hour event runs from 1 to 3 p.m. at 416 Boston Post Road E, with admission set at $65 per person.
 Organized by Reclaimed and Refined, the workshop will introduce participants to decorative resin techniques used to create ocean wave effects on charcuterie boards. The admission fee includes all materials and supplies required to complete the project, according to a community announcement reported by cwibc.co.id.
 Advertisement 
 Scroll To Continue with Content 
 No previous crafting experience is necessary. Each participant will have the opportunity to produce an individual resin board during the scheduled session.

 Reclaimed and Refined operates as a do-it-yourself craft studio in Coventry, Rhode Island. The organization regularly arranges creative workshops at breweries, wineries, and restaurants throughout southern New England, according to the community announcement.
 Its workshop format brings practical craft activities into hospitality venues, allowing attendees to work on individual projects while participating in organized sessions at local businesses.
 For the Marlborough event, the featured activity centers on creating a decorative charcuterie board with a resin-based ocean wave design. The November 22 workshop will take place at Tackle Box Brewing, with the $65 admission covering the necessary project materials.
